dict.string: Toby reads your contacts when you use Apple Contacts integration.
Toby reads and manages your calendars when you use Apple Calendar integration.
Toby needs full calendar access to search, create, update, and delete events.
Toby reads and manages your reminders when you use Apple Reminders integration.
Toby needs full reminders access to search, create, update, complete, and delete reminders.
Toby uses your location when you ask where you are or need location-aware help.

Toby records microphone audio when you use Record Audio.
Toby captures system audio for recordings when you use Record Audio.
